##Setup
```{r wd and packages}
for (lib in c('tidyverse','vegan','ggpubr')){
  if(!(lib %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])){install.packages(lib)}
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(lib, character.only = TRUE))
}

set.seed(80521)
```

#1) 16s ordination
```{r 1.a read in data}
data <- readRDS('rarefied_16s_asv_table.rds')
metadata <- read_csv('metadata_IFGvSBC.csv') 
```

```{r 1.c dataframe setup for NMDS}
flip <- data %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata) 
```

```{r, 1.d Distance Matrix, NMDS, and Permanova}
#calculate bray-curtis distance, dropping non-numeric/non-count data columns
bk.dist <- as.matrix(vegdist(select(flip, -c(Sample,colnames(metadata)))),method = "bray", na.rm = TRUE)

#Permanova, IFG vs SBC + Watershed
perm <- adonis2(bk.dist ~ Watershed + IFG_SBC, data = flip, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
perm

#Run the NMDS
NMDS <- metaMDS(bk.dist, trymax = 200)

#pull the points
MDS1 = NMDS$points[,1]
MDS2 = NMDS$points[,2]
NMDS_Points = data.frame(NMDS1 = MDS1, NMDS2 = MDS2)
```

```{r 1.e Plot NMDS}
n_stress_lab = paste0("stress = ",round(NMDS$stress, digits = 4),"\nn = ", nrow(flip))
permanova_lab <- paste0(" Watershed: p = ",perm$`Pr(>F)`[1],', r² = ',round(perm$R2[1], digits = 3),
                        "\nSubstratum: p = ",perm$`Pr(>F)`[2],", r² = ", round(perm$R2[2], digits = 3))

NMDS_plot <- ggplot(NMDS_Points, aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2))+ 
  geom_point(size = 5, aes(col=flip$IFG_SBC, shape = flip$Watershed))+
  labs(color = "Substratum", shape= "Watershed")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 19, 24)) +  #change shape of points
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = I(0.69), y = I(0.95),
           label = permanova_lab,
           parse = FALSE,
           size = 4) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = I(0.15), y = I(0.95),
           label = n_stress_lab,
           parse = FALSE,
           size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkcyan','goldenrod2'))+ #change color of points
  #stat_ellipse(aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2, col=flip$IFG_SBC)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,0.45)) +
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.4,0.6, by = 0.2)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.6,0.4, by = 0.2)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'none')
NMDS_plot
```

##Jack's Gulch 16s
```{r 1.c.1 JACK Distance Matrix, NMDS, and Permanova}
jg.flip <- flip %>%
  filter(Watershed =="JACK")
#calculate bray-curtis distance, dropping non-numeric/non-count data columns
jg.bk.dist <- as.matrix(vegdist(select(jg.flip, -c(Sample,colnames(metadata)))),method = "bray", na.rm = TRUE)

#Permanova, IFG vs SBC + Watershed
perm <- adonis2(jg.bk.dist ~ IFG_SBC, data = jg.flip, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
perm

#Run the NMDS
NMDS <- metaMDS(jg.bk.dist, trymax = 200)

#pull the points
MDS1 = NMDS$points[,1]
MDS2 = NMDS$points[,2]
jg.NMDS_Points = data.frame(NMDS1 = MDS1, NMDS2 = MDS2)

#pull statistics
jg.n_stress_lab = paste0("stress = ",round(NMDS$stress, digits = 4),"\nn = ", nrow(jg.flip))
jg.permanova_lab <- paste0("Substratum: p = ",perm$`Pr(>F)`[1],', r² = ',round(perm$R2[1], digits = 3))
```

```{r 1.c.2 JACK Plot NMDS}
jg.16.NMDS_plot <- ggplot(jg.NMDS_Points, aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2))+ 
  geom_point(size = 5, aes(col=jg.flip$IFG_SBC), shape =15)+
  labs(color = "Substratum", shape= "Watershed")+
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = I(0.69), y = I(0.98),
           label = jg.permanova_lab,
           parse = FALSE,
           size = 4) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = I(0.15), y = I(0.95),
           label = jg.n_stress_lab,
           parse = FALSE,
           size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkcyan','goldenrod2'))+ #change color of points
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.4,0.45)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'none')
#jg.16.NMDS_plot
```

#2) Now for the 18s Ordination
```{r 2.a.1 read in the 18s data}
data.18 <- readRDS('rarefied_18s_asv_table.rds')
taxonomy.18 <- read_csv('taxonomy_18S.csv')
```

```{r 2.a.2 get non-protist ASVs}
non.protist <- taxonomy.18 %>%
  filter(Phylum == 'p__Vertebrata' | Class %in% c("c__Insecta", "c__Arachnida") | Domain %in% c("d__Bacteria", "d__Archaea")) %>%
  pull(ASV_ID)
```

```{r 2.c setup the dataframe}
flip.18 <- data.18 %>%
  select(-any_of(non.protist)) %>% #these are already removed in making the rarefied feature table
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata) 
```

```{r, 2.d Distance Matrix, NMDS, and Permanova}
set.seed(80521)

#calculate bray-curtis distance, dropping non-numeric/non-count data columns
bk.dist.18 <- as.matrix(vegdist(select(flip.18, -c(Sample,colnames(metadata)))),method = "bray", na.rm = TRUE)

#Permanova, IFG vs SBC + Watershed
perm.18 <- adonis2(bk.dist.18 ~ Watershed + IFG_SBC, data = flip.18, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
perm.18

#Run the NMDS
NMDS.18 <- metaMDS(bk.dist.18, trymax = 200)

#pull the points
MDS1.18 = NMDS.18$points[,1]
MDS2.18 = NMDS.18$points[,2]
NMDS_Points.18 = data.frame(NMDS1 = MDS1.18, NMDS2 = MDS2.18)
```

```{r 2.e Plot the NMDS}
n_stress_lab.18 = paste0("stress = ",round(NMDS.18$stress, digits = 4),"\nn = ", nrow(flip.18))
permanova_lab.18 <- paste0("  Watershed: p = ",perm.18$`Pr(>F)`[1],', r² = ',round(perm.18$R2[1], digits = 3),
                        "\nSubstratum: p = ",perm.18$`Pr(>F)`[2],", r² =  ", round(perm.18$R2[2], digits = 3))

NMDS_plot.18 <- ggplot(NMDS_Points.18, aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2))+ 
  geom_point(size = 5, aes(col=flip.18$IFG_SBC, shape = flip.18$Watershed))+
  labs(color = "Substratum", shape= "Watershed")+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(15, 19, 24)) +  #change shape of points
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = I(0.69), y = I(0.95),
           label = permanova_lab.18,
           parse = FALSE,
           size = 4) +
  annotate(geom = 'text', x = I(0.15), y = I(0.95),
           label = n_stress_lab.18,
           parse = FALSE,
           size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkcyan','goldenrod2'))+ #change color of points
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5,0.5)) +
  #stat_ellipse(aes(x=NMDS1, y=NMDS2, col=flip$IFG_SBC)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_blank(),            # wont cover up data
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11),           # smaller text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),          # smaller title
        legend.key.size = unit(0.8, 'lines'),           # smaller symbols
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, 'cm'),             # tighter vertical spacing
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, 'pt'),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 0, l = 5),  # tighter margins
        legend.position = 'inside',
        legend.position.inside = c(.18, .01),
        legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
        legend.direction = "horizontal")
#NMDS_plot.18
```

###Vertical
```{r 3.a combine the plots}
ordi.all <- ggarrange(NMDS_plot,NMDS_plot.18,
                      jg.16.NMDS_plot, jg.18.NMDS_plot,
                      lb.16.NMDS_plot, lb.18.NMDS_plot,
                      pn.16.NMDS_plot,pn.18.NMDS_plot,
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 4,
                    align = 'hv',
                    labels = c('a','e','b','f','c','g','d','h'), #auto if going horizontal
                    font.label = list(size = 20, color = 'black', face = 'bold', family = NULL)) 
```


```{r 3.b save the final plot}
ggexport(
  filename="Ordi_Main_Rarefied_vertical.png",
  plot = ordi.all,
  dpi = 600,
  width = 19200 / 25.4, #ggexport uses inches for dimensions
  height = 38400 / 25.4
)
```
